name: Momenta
sub: OEM data flywheel across 680k+ Momenta-equipped vehicles
regions: China; Germany testing planned with partners
about: Chinese autonomous-driving software supplier combining mass-production ADAS with robotaxi ambitions. Their strategic edge is broad OEM data flywheel rather than a single captive fleet.
model: Licenses assisted-driving/autonomy software to OEMs and develops robotaxi technology.
financing: Public, Hong Kong IPO in July 2026 raising about $751M
investors: GM, Mercedes, Toyota, SAIC, Tencent, Uber, Grab
opMaturity: Commercial-scaled in ADAS; robotaxi pre-commercial / pilot
deployment: China OEM ADAS programs and autonomous-driving development; verify latest robotaxi footprint
metrics: 680,000+ vehicles equipped with Momenta systems by end-2025; ~$751M raised in the July 2026 Hong Kong IPO at a ~$9B valuation, with about 20% of proceeds earmarked for robotaxi commercialization.
signal: Bridges Chinese ADAS scale, autonomy software and map/localization data flywheels

sources.title: Momenta, Uber to start robotaxi testing in Germany in 2026
